content.html:
• This has been a good week for lamb. Relatedly it’s also starting to get very cold, and I need a new winter coat!
  • Lots of time spent working on an audit tool this week and getting good results.
  • Bar Trench is pretty good, I understand the hype.
  • Lots of small improvements to my Kanji study tool, including brand new mnemonics that I think are better?
  • Partly powered by a new library for rendering ruby text (or furigana) in Markdown.
  • Got a new homework assignment this week, this is a note to myself so that I don’t forget.
  • Someone told me you can't get flouride in Japan. This is demonstrably untrue.
  • Ginza was fun, and I totally agree, wearing Star Trek costumes to a Star Wars convention is a hilarious bit.
  • Enough people have now recommended Jojo to me that I think I have to watch it?
  • Inspired by seemingly everyone else I know, I started the new Zelda game, and my progress is slow but it all feels very satisfying.
  • Weekend was a lot of cleaning, studying and learning. Not exciting I know but, this is a marathon not a sprint.
